content: PS1 aesthetic checklist fans expect: low internal render resolution upscaled nearest-neighbor; vertex snapping (integer screen-space position quantization causing wobble); affine-style texture warping; ordered dithering for gradients/dithered shading; reduced color depth; fog/distance culling to hide draw distance; low-poly models; UI rendered at low res like the 3D scene. Reference: Copetti PS1 architecture analysis; PSX visual suites (vertex snap + affine + fog + dither post).
